name: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Dataset
description: We used a 3D simulator to create artificial video data with standardized annotations, aiming to aid in the development of Embodied AI. Our question answering (QA) dataset measures the extent to which a robot can understand human behavior and the environment in a home setting. Preliminary experiments suggest our dataset is useful in measuring AI's comprehension of daily life. \end{abstract}
evaluation_method: accuracy (QA correctness), often with question-type breakdowns and temporal reasoning-specific metrics
reputation: New / preliminary dataset (from a recent preprint); limited adoption so far beyond the authors' group and early Embodied AI researchers.
notes: Synthetic 3D-simulated videos with standardized annotations — useful for controlled evaluation but may have limited real-world realism. Designed for embodied/visual reasoning (non-LLM); different question types may vary widely in difficulty.
